units.source_text: 然而，他当然不是完全原谅了女人。

en.t: However, of course, he had not completely forgiven the woman.

units.source_text: 钉是钉，铆是铆，大致得有个区别。

en.t: A nail was a nail and a rivet was a rivet; there had to be some basic distinction.

units.source_text: 三天的休假老早就过去了。

en.t: His three-day leave had long since passed.

units.source_text: 已经到了现在这地步，再心急慌忙怕也来不及了吧。

en.t: Now that things had come this far, it was probably too late to panic and hurry.

units.source_text: 最初的计划，弄坍崖，让倾斜度变缓，说是计划失败，倒应该说是准备不足。

en.t: The original plan had been to collapse the cliff and make the slope gentler; rather than calling it a failure, it should be called insufficient preparation.

units.source_text: 要不是那被称作“日晒病”的不测事态作梗，那事情本该能做好的。

en.t: If not for the unforeseen trouble called sunstroke getting in the way, that matter should have been handled properly.

units.source_text: 只是挖沙这件事，实在是一项比想象激烈得多的劳动，要是有出色技巧的话，这种方法无疑是最有效的。

en.t: Only, digging sand was in fact far more strenuous work than he had imagined, and if one had excellent technique, this method was undoubtedly the most effective.

units.source_text: 于是，当他回过神来的时候，首先想到的就是以这场假病来作战。

en.t: So when he came back to his senses, the first thing he thought of was to fight by using this feigned illness.
